description: A signed Human decision request. It is a question, not a change: it binds the exact ledger head and state revision it was drafted against, because a request drafted while looking at a screen and submitted after the ledger moved is a decision about something that is no longer there, and it looks identical to a fresh one.

action.description: Closed set. An action not here cannot be drafted; HIDE_COMPLETED_WITH_EXCEPTION, MARK_GATE_PASS, MERGE, MUTATE_TASK_STATE, PERSIST_RAW_PAGE_BODY_OR_PRIVATE_REASONING, PROMOTE_RELEASE, ROLLBACK_PRODUCTION, UNSCOPED_FORCE_SKIP, WIDEN_TOOLS_PERMISSIONS_OR_SECRETS, WRITE_LEDGER_EVENT are refused by name.

request_id.description: Keyed on content. The same decision submitted twice is one request; a nonce would have made it two, and one Human clicking twice is not two decisions.

scope.description: Only a scoped exception has one, and it carries subject, gate and expires_after_revisions. An exception without all three is an unscoped force-skip with a better name.

signer_key_id.description: Only the key id travels. The key itself is Human-held and never enters this repository, a flag, or a receipt.

title: Harness Console decision request
